newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 1-2 jet fuel Apr cargoes around $212/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 1-2 jet fuel Apr cargoes around $212/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender one to two 32,000-tonne cargoes of jet fuel at around $212 per tonne, for April 22-29 delivery, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The cargo is for delivery to Keelung ot Shen Ao on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
Traders said the first cargo was purchased from a South Korean refiner at $212.90 per tonne, while the second cargo could have been awarded to a Dutch trader at $213.50 per tonne.
In its last tender, Taiwan bought two cargoes at around $236 per tonne, for March 15-19 and March 22-31 deliveries, c-and-f basis.
Traders said the lower price for April cargoes, reflected the steeply backwardated jet fuel market in Singapore.
